tldr: 全球半導體與 AI 股在 10/27 續強，帶動那斯達克再創收盤新高。
博通與 Anthropic 的 AI 晶片大單是主要推手，強化市場對 AI 資料中心需求延續的預期。
投資人聚焦聯準會兩天政策會議與密集財報週，審慎布局。

items.title_zh: 全球晶片股勁揚 為台積電領軍的台股權值股定調
items.title_en: Global chip rally sets an upbeat tone for TSMC-led Taiwan large-caps
items.summary_zh: 美股 10/27 在半導體與 AI 族群強勢帶動下續創新高，那斯達克單日漲逾 1%，市場同時受 Anthropic 遞交上市申請激勵。由於台積電與台灣晶圓代工、供應鏈大廠正是這波 AI 晶片需求的核心，國際盤的偏多氛圍通常牽動隔日台股權值股的開盤情緒，後續可留意外資對半導體龍頭的買賣超動向。
items.summary_en: A powerful rally in semiconductor and AI names pushed the Nasdaq to fresh highs on Oct. 27, with chip strength and optimism over Anthropic's IPO filing lifting the broad market. Because TSMC and Taiwan's foundry and supply-chain giants sit at the center of that AI-chip demand, a constructive global session typically frames sentiment for Taiwan's heavyweight tech names at the following open.

items.title_zh: 博通與 Anthropic AI 大單 推升半導體需求
items.title_en: Broadcom–Anthropic AI deal powers semiconductor demand
items.summary_zh: 博通與 AI 新創 Anthropic 達成大型 AI 晶片合作，成為近期科技股走強的關鍵動能，也強化市場對先進 AI 加速器與客製化晶片需求延續的預期。此案凸顯 AI 資料中心持續擴建，相關訂單可望外溢至負責製造與封測的台灣晶圓代工、先進封裝及零組件供應鏈，為相關族群中長期動能增添想像空間。
items.summary_en: Broadcom's large new AI chip agreement with Anthropic has become a key driver of the current tech rally, reinforcing expectations of sustained demand for advanced AI accelerators and custom silicon. The news spotlights the deepening build-out of AI data-center capacity, a trend that flows directly to Taiwan's foundry, advanced-packaging and component suppliers that manufacture and assemble these high-end chips.
